title: Transport lab 2: newer routes
blurb: WebRTC sender settings that keep text at full size, an RTCDataChannel in a worker, SharedArrayBuffer under Document-Isolation-Policy, WebTransport, Element Capture, and a test of what stops when the tab is frozen.
question: Which transport APIs from Chrome 130 to 160 carry a drawn element, and what stops when the browser freezes the source tab?
result: maintain-framerate-and-resolution keeps a 960×540 element at 960×540 where the default shrinks it to 320×180. A frame with Document-Isolation-Policy gets shared memory. WebTransport has no server here.
